# KanjiVG stroke data

These SVG files come from [KanjiVG](https://kanjivg.tagaini.net) release `r20250816` and are
Copyright (C) 2009–2025 Ulrich Apel. They are distributed under the
[Creative Commons Attribution-Share Alike 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/) licence;
each file keeps its original copyright header.

Only the characters Kana Dojo uses are included. Refresh them with `node scripts/fetch-kanjivg.ts`
after changing `KANJIVG_VERSION` in `src/ui/kanjivg.ts` (delete the old files first).
